احتجبوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَبُوا (iḥtajabū) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# اِحْتَجِبُوا (iḥtajibū) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
